text: ぜひ　みに　いきたいが　やっぱり　わしは　ジジイ　むりは　できん！

structure.jp: ぜひ　みに　いきたいが
structure.en: I'd love to go and see, but

structure.jp: やっぱり　わしは　ジジイ
structure.en: after all I'm an old man

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: A verb stem plus に before a going verb says what you go to do. みに　いきたい = 'want to go to see'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb stem says you want to do it. いきたい = 'I want to go'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が after a full sentence means 'but'. いきたいが = 'I want to go, but'.
